mapper.select: select * from ( select 'WEBHOOK'::text as source,id,terminal_event_key,event_type,delivery_status,attempt, next_retry_at,delivery_claim_until as claim_until,response_body as error_message,created_at from batch.webhook_delivery_log where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and terminal_event_key is not null union all select 'RULE'::text as source,id,terminal_event_key,event_type,delivery_status,attempt, next_retry_at,delivery_claim_until as claim_until,error_message,created_at from batch.notification_delivery_log where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and terminal_event_key is not null union all select 'PUSH'::text as source,id,terminal_event_key,event_type, coalesce(delivery_status,decision) as delivery_status,attempt,next_retry_at, delivery_claim_until as claim_until, coalesce(error_message,case when record_type='DECISION' then 'intake decision: '||decision end) as error_message,created_at from batch.console_push_job_delivery where tenant_id=#{tenantId} union all select 'WEBHOOK'::text as source,c.id,c.terminal_event_key,c.event_type,c.delivery_status as delivery_status, c.attempt,c.next_retry_at,c.delivery_claim_until as claim_until, c.response_body as error_message,c.created_at from archive.webhook_delivery_log_archive c where c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and not exists (select 1 from batch.webhook_delivery_log h where h.tenant_id=c.tenant_id and h.id=c.id) union all select 'RULE'::text as source,c.id,c.terminal_event_key,c.event_type,c.delivery_status as delivery_status, c.attempt,c.next_retry_at,c.delivery_claim_until as claim_until, c.error_message as error_message,c.created_at from archive.notification_delivery_log_archive c where c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and not exists (select 1 from batch.notification_delivery_log h where h.tenant_id=c.tenant_id and h.id=c.id) union all select 'PUSH'::text as source,c.id,c.terminal_event_key,c.event_type,coalesce(c.delivery_status,c.decision) as delivery_status, c.attempt,c.next_retry_at,c.delivery_claim_until as claim_until, coalesce(c.error_message,case when c.record_type='DECISION' then 'intake decision: '||c.decision end) as error_message,c.created_at from archive.console_push_job_delivery_archive c where c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and not exists (select 1 from batch.console_push_job_delivery h where h.tenant_id=c.tenant_id and h.id=c.id) ) deliveries order by created_at desc,id desc,source limit #{limit}

select #{source}::text as source,id,terminal_event_key,event_type,delivery_status,attempt, next_retry_at,delivery_claim_until as claim_until, as error_message,created_at from where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and id=#{id} and terminal_event_key is not null for update

select #{source}::text as source,id,terminal_event_key,event_type,delivery_status,attempt, next_retry_at,delivery_claim_until as claim_until, as error_message,created_at from where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and id=#{id} and terminal_event_key is not null

select params::text from batch.console_operation_audit where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and aggregate_type='NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY' and aggregate_id=#{aggregateId} and action='NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_RETRY' and request_id=#{requestId} union select params::text from archive.console_operation_audit_archive where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and aggregate_type='NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY' and aggregate_id=#{aggregateId} and action='NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_RETRY' and request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.update: update set attempt=0,delivery_status=#{targetStatus},next_retry_at=current_timestamp, delivery_claim_token=null,delivery_claim_until=null where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and id=#{id} and terminal_event_key is not null and delivery_status='EXHAUSTED' and next_retry_at is null and (delivery_claim_until is null or delivery_claim_until <= current_timestamp)
